paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: Proportion of incorrectly answered samples where RPop_Ge is less than RPop_GT.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the proportion of incorrectly answered samples, expressed as a percentage, where the knowledge popularity of the generated response (RPop_Ge) is less than the knowledge popularity of the ground truth (RPop_GT), across three different categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the ratio in percentage, ranging from 50% to 90%, with horizontal grid lines at 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, and 90%. The horizontal axis displays the three categories, listed in the order: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. For each category, three bars are presented, corresponding to the models Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow), as indicated by the legend. In the Movies category, Llama3 and Qwen2 have the highest ratios, both exceeding 90%, while ChatGPT has a ratio of approximately 74%. In the Songs category, Qwen2 again has the highest ratio, slightly above 90%, followed by Llama3 at approximately 85%, and ChatGPT at around 64%. In the Basketball category, Llama3 has a ratio of approximately 68%, Qwen2 has a ratio of approximately 58%, and ChatGPT has a ratio of approximately 62%. The bars are grouped by category, with each group containing one bar for each model, and are presented in the order of the models as listed in the legend.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the proportion of incorrectly answered samples, expressed as a percentage, where the popularity rank of the retrieved knowledge (RPop_Ge) is less than the ground truth popularity rank (RPop_GT), across three different domains—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—for three language models: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). The vertical axis represents the ratio in percentage, ranging from 50% to 90%, with horizontal gridlines at 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, and 90%. In the Movies domain, Llama3 and Qwen2 both achieve high performance with ratios of approximately 90%, while ChatGPT shows a lower ratio of about 73%. In the Songs domain, Llama3 and Qwen2 again perform similarly, with ratios of approximately 84% and 90% respectively, and ChatGPT's ratio is around 63%. In the Basketball domain, Llama3 has a ratio of about 67%, Qwen2 has a ratio of about 57%, and ChatGPT has a ratio of approximately 62%. The chart shows that Llama3 and Qwen2 consistently outperform ChatGPT in the Movies and Songs domains, while the performance gap narrows in the Basketball domain. The bars are grouped by domain, with each group containing three bars representing the three models, and the models are identified by a legend at the top of the chart.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt den Anteil der falsch beantworteten Proben, bei denen der RPop_Ge-Wert kleiner ist als der RPop_GT-Wert, unterteilt nach drei Kategorien – Movies, Songs und Basketball – und vergleicht drei Modelle: Llama3, Qwen2 und ChatGPT. Die vertikale Achse repräsentiert den Anteil in Prozent (%) und reicht von 50 bis 90 mit Beschriftungen in Schritten von 10. Die horizontale Achse listet die drei Kategorien in der Reihenfolge Movies, Songs und Basketball. Für jede Kategorie sind drei farbige Balken gruppiert: blau für Llama3, rot für Qwen2 und gelb für ChatGPT. In der Kategorie Movies erreicht der Balken für Llama3 einen Wert von etwa 90 %, der für Qwen2 etwa 91 % und der für ChatGPT etwa 74 %. In der Kategorie Songs beträgt der Wert für Llama3 etwa 85 %, für Qwen2 etwa 90 % und für ChatGPT etwa 64 %. In der Kategorie Basketball liegt der Wert für Llama3 bei etwa 68 %, für Qwen2 bei etwa 57 % und für ChatGPT bei etwa 62 %. Die Balken sind in jeder Gruppe nebeneinander angeordnet, wobei die Farben durch eine Legende oben im Diagramm identifiziert werden. Die Kategorien auf der horizontalen Achse sind alphabetisch geordnet, und es gibt keine visuellen Hervorhebungen wie Schattierungen oder Fettdruck.
